enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Extend legs. Pull blanket. Snore. Wake briefly. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

Open eyes and sit up. Swing legs out of bed and stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap and light. Walk out.
Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook. Put eggs on plate. Pour milk. Sit and eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Go to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Check phone. Pick up bag. Walk to door.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Take lunch break. Eat sandwich. Return to work. Attend patient. Assist doctor. Clean equipment. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Stand up. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to living room. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV.
Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Type reply. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Close browser. Shut down laptop.
Go to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Adjust lamp. Continue reading. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Go to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Snore. Wake briefly. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.
